diagnosis.reason: The envelope itself was already committed and compiled successfully. A manually precomputed SHA-256 pointer copied into the draft/accepted authoring metadata was wrong. The v0.8 read-only audit detected the mismatch before seal or primary execution.

correction.acceptance_metadata_refresh_allowed: AUTHOR_ACCEPTANCE.json may refresh its draft commit/blob identity to the corrected draft and record this amendment, without changing accepted scope, evidence audit, required statements, uncertainties, or scientific interpretation.

allowed_changes: Replace only the incorrect envelope SHA-256 pointer with the actual SHA-256 of the already-committed envelope in the draft instance, accepted instance, and acceptance frozen-input metadata.
Refresh AUTHOR_ACCEPTANCE.json draft commit/blob identity after the corrected draft commit.
Add an explicit amendment reference to AUTHOR_ACCEPTANCE.json.
Update the Unit 002-R acceptance verifier so it checks the corrected draft/accepted status-only relationship and this amendment identity.
forbidden_changes: Changing SOURCE_LANE.json, TARGET_LANE.json, BOUNDARY_MODEL.json, vbe.envelope.json, or any evidence bytes.
Changing any bounded world, effect cut, consequence label, target pattern, target fact, fact status, provenance edge, claim root, mechanism, interpreter, discriminator, or operative-signature fact.
Changing the enrolled target, target revision, operation, or selection order.
Changing the target-only qualification result or its interpretation.
Running or observing the Unit 002-R primary RISU verifier before the correction is committed and the read-only audit plus v0.8 seal pass.
interpretation: This amendment repairs a stale/wrong checksum pointer so the protocol-preserving preflight can bind the authoring metadata to bytes that were already frozen. It does not change those envelope bytes or any scientific proposition and therefore cannot predetermine PRESERVED, CONSEQUENCE_REGRESSION, or INCOMPLETE_ASSURANCE.
